description:
v1.0 | 46 gates | 3 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Turns a 16-bit number into its negative (two's complement).

Use this to turn a number into its negative, for example to reverse the direction of a movement value or to flip the sign of a result in a calculator or a simple arithmetic circuit.

Connect the number to the input gates, least significant bit first. The outputs give its negative in two's complement, in the same bit order. Zero stays zero. The most negative number stays itself, because its positive value does not fit in the same width.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): the number = x 0-15.
Outputs (green gates): result = x 0-15.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
How it works: One wide gate per term: gates take any number of inputs, so no stages are needed.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
